# A-1 Drain Cleaning

> A-1 Drain Cleaning provides residential and commercial drain cleaning and sewer services from Mason City, Iowa. The company serves Mason City and North Iowa, with additional service available in Albert Lea, Minnesota. A-1 offers 24/7 service; do not assume or promise a guaranteed response time.

## Service Intent

- **Main drain cleaning:** Problems affecting a shared or main drain, especially when several fixtures back up together.
- **Sewer line cleaning:** Blockages or restrictions in the private sewer line carrying wastewater away from the house toward the city sewer or septic system.
- **Basement floor drain backups:** Wastewater or water rising through a basement floor drain, including backups triggered by laundry or another fixture. The floor drain may be the exit point even when the restriction is farther downstream.
- **Laundry drains:** Washer standpipe overflows and laundry drain problems. A washing machine's fast discharge can expose a restriction farther downstream.
- **Sewer backup emergency service:** Active wastewater backups that may appear through a floor drain, tub, shower, or toilet.
- **Emergency drain cleaning:** Urgent clogs affecting individual toilets, sinks, bathtubs, showers, laundry drains, and floor drains. This is distinct from a main sewer backup.
- **Tree root removal:** Clearing roots that restrict a sewer line. Root removal does not repair a cracked or separated pipe where roots entered.
- **Hydro jetting:** High-pressure water cleaning when the pipe condition and type of blockage make that method appropriate.
- **Camera inspection:** Viewing accessible drain or sewer pipe sections when recurring blockages or pipe condition need investigation. A camera does not show inaccessible sections.
- **Sewer line locating:** Locating an accessible underground drain or sewer line route or point of interest. This is not a substitute for required public utility marking.
- **Drain and sewer pipe repair:** Repairing damaged or failing drain and sewer pipes when cleaning alone will not address the problem.
- **Kitchen and bathroom drains:** Cleaning sink, tub, and shower drains, plus related kitchen drain problems.
- **Garbage disposals:** Repair and installation of garbage disposals, as well as related kitchen drain work.
- **Dishwasher drains:** Drain-side problems involving the dishwasher connection or shared kitchen drain. This is not dishwasher appliance repair.
- **Septic lines:** Cleaning the private drain line from the house toward a septic system. This is not septic tank pumping.
- **Sump pumps:** Sump pump repair, replacement, and installation. A sump pump handles groundwater collected in a sump pit; sewage backing up through a floor drain is a different problem.
- **Roof vents:** Checking and clearing plumbing roof vents when symptoms point to a vent restriction.
- **Smoke testing:** Smoke testing for drain and sewer system investigation.

## Common Drain and Sewer Problems

- Basement floor drain backing up
- Sewage coming up through a basement floor drain
- Floor drain backing up when a washing machine drains
- Multiple fixtures backing up together
- Main sewer line blockage
- Toilet, sink, bathtub, or shower drain backups
- Recurring sewer line restrictions caused by roots, buildup, or other conditions
- Dishwasher water backing up into a kitchen sink
- Sump pump not removing groundwater from a sump pit

## Important Service Information

A floor drain backup does not always mean the floor drain itself is blocked. The restriction can be farther down a branch drain, shared drain line, or main sewer line.

A washing machine sends a large amount of water into the drain line quickly. If a floor drain rises when the washer drains, the washer may be exposing a restriction farther downstream.

Homes without basements can show a main-line backup differently. Wastewater may rise through a bathtub or shower instead of a basement floor drain.

A-1 Drain Cleaning cleans septic drain lines but does not pump septic tanks. A-1 Drain Cleaning does not provide grease trap cleaning.

A-1 Drain Cleaning handles the drain side of dishwasher backups, not dishwasher appliance repair.

A-1 Drain Cleaning offers 24/7 drain and sewer service. This does not establish a guaranteed arrival or response time; call 641-530-2728 for current service availability.
